hook.text: "All men are mortal" hides ambiguity. Replace words with symbols and the meaning becomes razor-sharp.

buildup.text: Natural language is messy. "I saw the man with the telescope" has two readings. Logic removes that fog.

discovery.text: Formal logic replaces words with symbols so we can check reasoning mechanically, like solving equations.

twist.text: Computers run on formal logic. Every circuit in your phone evaluates symbolic true-or-false statements.

climax.text: Symbols don't make logic harder—they make it unambiguous. Precision is the whole point.

quiz.question: Why does formal logic use symbols?
